label: Candid PCS Populations
description: A small illustrative subset of Candid's Philanthropy Classification System (PCS) Populations facet, used to demonstrate CommonGood Atlas's classification-assignment mechanism -- NOT a reproduction of Candid's actual licensed PCS taxonomy. Real codes and coverage should be imported from Candid's own published taxonomy release before this scheme is used for anything beyond illustration. Multiple population classifications on the same Population resource are valid, since a population may have several characteristics at once.
